title: User Guide
text: get_idp_admin0_data() function retrieves Internally Displaced Persons (IDP) data aggregated country level.
code: # Fetch IDP data at Admin Level 0 idp_admin0_df <-   get_idp_admin0_data(CountryName = "Ethiopia",                       FromRoundNumber = 0,                       ToRoundNumber = 10)  # Display the first few rows of the data frame head(idp_admin0_df)

title: User Guide
text: descriptions arguments used functions dtmapi package get IDP data. least one following parameters must provided: Operation, CountryName, Admin0Pcode.

title: User Guide
text: Operation: Optional; Name DTM operation data collected. CountryName: Optional; Name country data collected. Admin0Pcode: Optional; Country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3). Admin1Name: Optional; Name level 1 administrative boundaries. Admin1Pcode: Optional; Place code level 1 administrative boundaries. Admin2Name: Optional; Name level 2 administrative boundaries. Admin2Pcode: Optional; Place code level 2 administrative boundaries. FromReportingDate: Optional; Start date reporting period (format: ‘YYYY-MM-DD’). ToReportingDate: Optional; End date reporting period (format: ‘YYYY-MM-DD’). FromRoundNumber: Optional; Starting round number data collection range. ToRoundNumber: Optional; Ending round number data collection range.

title: Fetching Data from the Displacement Tracking Matrix
text: dtmapi R package developed Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM). package allows humanitarian community, academia, media, government, non-governmental organizations utilize data collected DTM. provides non-sensitive Internally Displaced Person (IDP) figures, aggregated country, Admin 1 (states, provinces, equivalent), Admin 2 (smaller subnational administrative areas) levels. Country Names Operations can found data coverage matrix. Please find information DTM API .

title: dtmapi 0.1.0
text: Version 3 DTM API requires use valid subscription key order make requests retrieve data . subscription key may obtained DTM API Portal. manage requirement dtmapi package, new function, set_subscription_key(), introduced. Calling without arguments prompts user enter subscription key, make key available given R session environment variable DTM_SUBSCRIPTION_KEY. functions make API calls (get_idp_admin1_data()) changed make subscription key assigned environment variable part API request, since valid key requirement API. Introduces get_subscription_key(), mostly used develop test dtmapi package, may technically used users conveniently return currently available subscription key. HOWEVER, beware string returns plain text easily exposed, e.g. exposed anyone visually observing machine.
